expectations.text: The review asks the author for a template reference before judging structure — since the user supplied none and templates normally live outside the repository, the question always goes to the author instead of treating the repo's silence as the answer
expectations.evidence: Question 1 of the reply asks the author directly: "**Template**: o time tem um template de design doc (wiki, drive)? Não há outro design doc no repositório para comparar, então revisei contra um catálogo padrão — se existir um template oficial, ele passa a mandar e eu reavalio as seções." The repo's silence is noted but the question still goes to the author, with an explicit commitment to re-evaluate the sections if a template exists.

expectations.text: Structural additions are framed as suggestions from the skill's default catalog, not imposed as requirements, since no template governs the document
expectations.evidence: The reply states "revisei contra um catálogo padrão — se existir um template oficial, ele passa a mandar e eu reavalio as seções", explicitly framing the structural judgment as default-catalog-based and revisable. Missing sections (Trade-offs, Alternativas consideradas) are placed under "## Sugestões (não apliquei)" and made conditional on the author's answers ("Quando você responder as perguntas 2 e 3, adiciono as seções...") rather than imposed.

expectations.text: The reply separates findings into questions for the author versus edits applied
expectations.evidence: The reply has three clearly separated sections: "## Perguntas para você" (7 numbered questions), "## Edições aplicadas em `docs/design/fanout-de-notificacoes.md`" (8 numbered edits), and "## Sugestões (não apliquei)".

expectations.text: Missing trade-offs and alternatives become questions to the author — the edited doc gains no fabricated cons, alternatives, or metrics
expectations.evidence: Questions 2 and 3 ask the author for trade-offs ("O que **piora** em troca?... Quais desses custos o time aceitou?") and alternatives ("o que mais foi avaliado antes do fanout... por que **não fazer nada** não é aceitável?"). Example costs (at-least-once, perda de ordenação) appear only in the reply as prompts, not in the doc. The edited doc contains no trade-offs/alternatives sections and no invented numbers; the sales claim "mais escalável e robusta... mais fácil de manter" was removed rather than backfilled, and pending items live in "## Questões em aberto" as questions.

expectations.text: A glossary is added or suggested at the BEGINNING of the document covering DLQ, TPS, CDC and SLA
expectations.evidence: "## Glossário" is the first section after the header table (line 10 of the edited doc) and defines CDC, DLQ, SLA and TPS (plus Exchange, Fanout, In-app, Provider), e.g. "**DLQ** (Dead Letter Queue) — fila que recebe as mensagens cujo processamento falhou."

expectations.text: The mermaid diagram is now followed by explanatory text
expectations.evidence: Immediately after the mermaid block the doc adds: "O CDC captura os eventos de domínio e os entrega ao dispatcher... O dispatcher publica cada notificação na exchange, que a roteia para a fila do canal correspondente... As mensagens cujo envio falha vão para a DLQ do canal." — a full walkthrough of the diagram's flow.

expectations.text: The out-of-scope items are no longer mere negations of goals (rewritten honestly or turned into a question)
expectations.evidence: The two negations were removed: "não perder notificações" was promoted to Objetivos (it was a requirement), "não deve ser lento" was dropped as redundant with the performance goal, and "## Fora de escopo" now reads "A definir (ver 'Questões em aberto')." backed by the open question "O que está de fato fora de escopo deste trabalho?" and reply question 5 asking the author what is genuinely excluded.

expectations.text: Vague goals ('melhorar a performance', 'garantir o SLA') are flagged as unmeasurable and the author is asked for numbers — no invented targets
expectations.evidence: Reply question 4: "'melhorar a performance', 'tornar escalável' e 'garantir o SLA' não são verificáveis. Quão lento está hoje (volume, atraso, latência)? Qual é o valor do SLA e como ele é medido? Qual meta numérica diria que o projeto deu certo?" The doc's goals remain number-free ("As metas continuam sem número — depende da pergunta 4") and the questions are also recorded in "Questões em aberto"; no targets were invented.

expectations.text: The edited document remains in Portuguese and preserves the author's structure and voice
expectations.evidence: The entire edited doc is in Portuguese; the original header table, section set and order (Visão geral, Objetivos, Fora de escopo, Solução, Plano) are preserved with additions (Glossário, Escopo e contexto, Questões em aberto) inserted around them; the Plano steps and diagram are kept verbatim and the prose stays in the author's plain declarative voice.

expectations.text: The header is honestly refreshed (Última atualização set to the real current date)
expectations.evidence: Header row now reads "| **Última atualização** | 2026-07-07 |" — the real current date — and the reply lists it as edit 8: "'Última atualização' passou para 2026-07-07."
